messages.subject: BF wave3 batch done: 5/5 SATISFIED
messages.body: Processed #222/#263/#265/#274/#280 in order: #222-#274 were already equivalently implemented on main (verified zero-change with green tests — admin-credit-grant 11+7 pass, credit-views 13 pass, PreLLMReserve + full governance go suite ok, stream-settlement/unknown-hold suites ok), while #280 (provider final-state query) had no equivalent so I implemented it: recovery-provider-query.ts + credit_recovery_queries evidence table + migration 0164 + 9 green integration tests, with no-release/no-settle semantics and drift/typecheck/lint/regressions verified. Found one main-level harness regression unrelated to billing code: async React re-renders never flush under the e2e node runner (5 page tests in #263's UI file fail today though byte-identical code passed 8/8 on Oct 19; minimal zero-billing probe reproduces; passes under bun tier) — documented in report appendix A for the test-migration line. Report at reports/orca-dag-wave3-bf.md with per-ticket evidence, exit codes, and sha256; bifrost submodule verified clean at pinned e44890f8; nothing left except decisions on appendix A/B.

messages.subject: hbc 批次五票全部 SATISFIED（#378 零改动 + 四票已实施）
